requirement_review.user_intent: Norven authorized Cap to push the current develop version record and then start the 360-degree old RedCap scan according to the planned order.

treat the scan account or Prism review as full revival completion
reopen provider policy beyond Kimi and Claude Code

prompt_context.source_prompt_excerpt: 好，按照你的规划和顺序去执行落地

task_body.primary_deliverable: A checked scan shard account and Phase 2 queue amendment that explicitly covers known portable-design and pathology domains.
acceptance_criteria: develop is confirmed synchronized with origin/develop
the scan account uses exact old files only and rejects directory or wildcard sources through prism-shard check
known no-promote pathology records are represented in the Phase 2 queue instead of being hidden outside the scan plan
the RedCap gate accepts the lifecycle packet before completion claims

findings: 360 扫描入口复用现有 Phase 2 蓝图和分片账目机制，不新增第二套扫描状态机。
